status: design only; not an executable recipe or measured result
objective: If national class/reference counts cannot establish Vercel fit, measure exact selected native-node degree, protected anchors and contraction edge counts before constructing a graph.
profile: Keep the already selected motorway/trunk/primary/secondary/tertiary plus links profile. Count the entire acquired file. No selected places, geographic exceptions or regional compression extrapolation.
streamingPlan: In a new qualified native source helper, keep all original whole-file guards. Emit fixed binary selected-way reference occurrences containing native node ID, source way ID, degree contribution and source-way endpoint flag. Emit tagged-node IDs in strict original node order and all relation node/way member IDs as separate bounded streams. Do not emit ordinary Python objects per national node.

Validate every selected reference against native source-node presence using a bounded one-bit-per-ID arena. Freeze its maximum from the already sealed full-source max-node-ID. This is a dense native resource arena, not a Python ID dictionary; high IDs beyond that finite bound stop before allocation. Do not emit or retain all1.6billion node IDs, and do not revive the slow per-way coordinate-index lookup. Tagged-node IDs remain a separate sorted stream.

Sort only fixed-size occurrence chunks with a bounded native sorter. Sort relation node/way ID streams with explicit aggregate RAM/disk caps. Preserve duplicates and occurrence counts; no national Python dictionaries, coordinate index, cell bank, source-way retention or graph allocation.

Merge sorted occurrence chunks by native node ID. Sum degree contributions (one at each way end; two at each internal occurrence), keep endpoint flags, intersect sorted tagged-node/relation-node streams and mark occurrences whose source way is a relation way member. Preserve every all-relation metadata dependency used by the prototype; no car permission or relation applicability inference.

A selected node is a retained anchor when its degree is not two, it is a source-way endpoint, it is tagged or it has retained relation context. For the whole acquired file, do not introduce the regional capture's artificial window cuts. Actual later clipping needs its own geometry/crossing rules.

Compute exact within-source-way contraction edge count as selectedWayCount plus the number of internal reference occurrences at retained anchors. Closed ways, repeated nodes, self loops, parallel ways, zero geometry and coincident-but-distinct IDs must remain represented.

Cross-check delivered reference count, endpoint occurrences=2*ways, total degree=2*primitive edges, all role/profile counters and original full-source semantic/raw/count/header/state/metadata/EOF seals. Record actual peak RAM, all simultaneously retained scratch/source/closed files and every timing scope. No fit claim from forecast ratios.

exactPrototypeArrayArithmetic.symbols: N=selected unique native nodes; V=retained anchors; E=contracted edges; P=primitive edges
exactPrototypeArrayArithmetic.routingBytes: 12*V + 24*E + 4 (xy.i32, offsets.u32, two undirected target.u32/meter.f64 arcs per edge)
exactPrototypeArrayArithmetic.fullGeometryBytes: 8*N + 4*P + 8*E + 4 (all native xy, chain offsets and P+E node occurrences)
exactPrototypeArrayArithmetic.scope: Exact isolated arrays for the prototype format if all u32 bounds hold; excludes metadata, JS/runtime/search state, app assets and packaged compression. Other representations may differ.

qualification: Before source use: independent synthetic graph/occurrence oracle, exact anchor and edge counts including loops/repeated IDs/parallel ways, independent sorted multiset and full raw-versus-contracted distance checks; chunk boundary/cap/order/truncation/overflow/EOF/deadline/owned-cleanup controls; actual targetLinux/compiler/ABI checks. Compare same native prototype semantics with any regional cut flags represented explicitly in validation only.
resourceDecision: Fill exact row, chunk, relation-stream, file, peak simultaneous scratch and retained-output bounds from the completed national histogram before freezing any command. Stay inside 4GiBzero swap/2CPU/four-hour/64GiB including at least62.6GBprior assets and all newer closed allocations. If the conservative envelope does not fit, stop before source execution and present a concrete alternative. Planned retained spool arithmetic:24*selectedReferences +8*allTaggedNodes +16*(allRelationNodeMembers+allRelationWayMembers), including unsorted/sorted relation stream copies. Source-node presence arena is ceil((maxSourceNodeID+1)/8) bytes of RAM. Sorting chunks and metadata arrays need explicit additional measured heap margins and exact namespace/file caps.
deferred: No graph construction, continental-only coverage claim, ordinary-car access/direction/turn policy, driving-time model, reference requests, application DB writes or deployment. Original accuracy/physical/package/startup/API/visual gates stay in place.
